verdict.rationale: Airweave's agent-facing tools (MCP server, CLI, skills, framework integrations) only let an agent search data synced from external sources. There is no evidence that an agent can add, update or delete its own memories mid-conversation. The Pipedream actions for managing collections and triggering syncs are adjacent data-source administration, not agent memory management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can manage its own memory mid-conversation — adding, searching, updating, and deleting memories through tools or API calls it invokes itself
